identity_cost.detail: A checkout with a 24-hour provisioning step: Set up within 24 hours; no free tier and no trial stated on the page.

record.reliability_note: unverified: single small provider, no uptime figure or audit read; the dedicated server has no failover in the offer as written.
record.confidence_note: All facts are from the vendor's own product page read. A measured claim would need a provisioned server, a forwarded port and a byte count; the absence of any published cap is itself the documented fact.

evidence.proved: Unlimited port forwarding on any external port mapped to any internal port, TCP, UDP or both, a static dedicated IP, WireGuard, $11.99 per month or $119.99 per year, no bandwidth charges, provisioning within 24 hours.
